name: Generalized Trilinear Interpolation
definition: A reconstruction method to interpolate AMR data across refinement level boundaries, ensuring C0 continuity and avoiding artifacts/cracks by using virtual unstructured elements to initialize octant vertices.
summary: Generalized Trilinear Interpolation computes field values at arbitrary points in adaptive mesh data by initializing octant vertices with precomputed weights, solving the neighbor misalignment issues that cause standard trilinear interpolation to fail.
